payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Built the capture route with shared photo validation/crop flow, note/source and text-only topic creation, viewport-derived card placement, import progress with cancel/retry, object URL cleanup, route wiring, and 19 targeted component tests; full suite (398), typecheck, lint, format, and production build pass.
decisions: Persisted viewport x/y is treated as the visible world top-left corner; placement centers at viewport.x + visibleWidth/(2*scale) with a small existing-card stagger.
Cancel during photo import is available before the atomic saving stage and returns to the case; once saving starts the control is hidden because IndexedDB writes cannot be interrupted safely.
Crop cancel returns to the picker, while failure Back returns to the case; both write no card.
interfaces: CapturePage({ repository?, loadRepository?, validateImage?, importCard?, readViewportSize? })
warnings: docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl contains a pre-existing engine-generated modification I did not author or touch.
Playwright/browser camera, real image decode, and tablet touch crop behavior were not run; component evidence is jsdom-based with injected validation/import functions.
CAP-3 opens its own cached production repository handle; a later composition pass may want to share the shelf loader.
validationLimitations: The case board does not exist yet, so viewport placement is validated against an injected 1000x800 visible size rather than a live Pixi board viewport.
Real EXIF, canvas, and file-input camera behavior remain for CAP-4/QA browser verification.
payload.taskDescription: Create CapturePage at /case/:caseId/capture with separate Take photo, Choose photo, and Add topic actions. The photo inputs accept image/jpeg, image/png, and image/webp; one uses capture=environment and the other does not. After selection, run imageValidation, show progress, open CropRotateEditor, then NoteSourceForm with type, title, and a Keep full resolution toggle that defaults off and warns about storage. TopicForm creates a text-only topic. Compute an initial position from the case viewport center with a small stagger, call card import or repository create, and navigate back to the case. Wire the route in src/app/routes.tsx. Do not implement card detail editing or OCR.
